notes: README.md is the English landing page and README.zh-CN.md is its complete Chinese translation.
Both landing pages begin with a linked table of contents and explicit install/invocation examples.
GitHub source installation is separated from locally generated platform release ZIPs.
Candidate identifiers are arbitrary and optional; PID is not required.
H-cap is calculation-only; results.csv presents the original star-containing repeat unit and rows.csv retains the audit copy.
The original upstream STCA scan/ranking/prefix-family algorithm is unchanged; only the skill adapter and documentation were revised.
Live platform publication and macOS host execution have not been performed by this package build.
adapter_changes: Calculation-only H-cap with original-star-SMILES primary output
New screen-candidates wrapper and results.csv/rows.csv split
